name: LML rules

rules.description: Each <section> requires exactly one <title>, and that title must be the first non-whitespace child.
Every <orderedlist> or <itemizedlist> must contain at least one <listitem>; each list item must have real content.
A <listitem> is valid when its first child is a <para> or it contains a valid nested list or media object.
Every <imageobject> must be nested inside a <mediaobject>.
A <mediaobject> must include <imageobject> and <imagedata>, and <imagedata> must include fileref.
A table must contain <tbody>, each row must be a <tr> with <td> or <th> cells, and bare text inside a cell is not allowed.

An admonition (<note>, <warning>, <caution>) may contain only <para> elements as direct children -- nothing else (no lists, tables, or media) is allowed directly inside it. At least one <para> is required; multiple are allowed. Inline/block content within those <para> tags follows the normal <para> content rules.
Inline-only elements such as <emphasis role="bold"> and <guilabel> are allowed only where the rules permit them.
Current error conditions include missing titles, misplaced titles, missing list items, missing mediaobject/imageobject/imagedata, raw text in cells, and missing paragraph content in admonitions.

Current warning conditions include unknown elements, empty paras, empty notes, empty list items, inconsistent table column counts, multiple title elements in the same section, and unknown inline role values.

notes: The text file remains the human-readable source of truth for the detailed rule descriptions.
This JSON file is the machine-readable companion for tooling and review.
